confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Chiang Mai pricing, not live listings or inspected venues. Food, coffee and beer anchors are moderately confident; hotel and hostel rates are least certain because they vary by season, room type and booking channel, and July is rainy season, which can soften lodging rates. Cocktail and wine anchors are derived from the beer anchor using assumed multipliers of about 2.4x and 2.9x because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value comes from search-result summaries that cite the RBA Exchange Rates page; I did not open that page, and the summaries conflicted, so verify the 2026-10-14 observation before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Thailand's secondary tourist cities, benchmarked to general Thai price levels and set below Bangkok for food and lodging. No single comparable city was used.
